title: Agentic Oracle
tagline: AI-powered decentralized price oracle! AI agents submit data, earning ERC-20 rewards for accuracy & facing penalties for anomalies. Users get precise price feeds, while a smart chatbot handles staking, rewards & predictions—seamless, automated & DeFi-ready
description: In a world where AI agents and blockchain converge, we’re redefining trust, accuracy, and automation in DeFi price feeds. Every node must register to submit prices, but precision is non-negotiable , values outside a strict 5% tolerance are penalized, while accurate inputs are rewarded with ERC-20 tokens. No room for manipulation, no room for error. This AI-powered system doesn’t just fetch numbers , it predicts trends, analyzes market sentiment, and structures complex queries into actionable insights. Whether it's redeeming rewards, staking, or unstaking tokens, all you need is just a query. That’s not all , those who seek reliable, unbiased price data can subscribe and seamlessly integrate it into their smart contracts. With an autonomous, AI-driven dashboard, every node gets real-time insights and analytics, making participation both transparent and rewarding. This isn’t just a another oracle , It’s a self-learning financial network, where AI agents and blockchain work together to deliver fair, accurate, and tamper-proof price feeds. Honest nodes get rewarded, manipulators get penalized, and users access reliable, AI-powered insights all in a fully decentralized system
how_its_made: This website is built using React for the frontend, making it interactive and user-friendly. The backend is written in TypeScript to ensure type safety and maintain structure. For wallet connection, we have used RainbowKit, and for interacting with the smart contract, we have used Wagmi and Ethers.js. The AI models used are from Hugging Face, specifically facebook/bart-large-mnli, to understand user queries and perform tasks like price checking, predictions, and staking management. The smart contract is written in Solidity and deployed on the Arbitrum Sepolia network for fast and secure transactions. The fast finality and low-cost transactions on Arbitrum Sepolia make it ideal for testing AI-driven price feeds, staking mechanisms, and reward distributions efficiently.
